message.subject: {name} sent you a message
message.preheader: Open WagStays to read it and reply.
message.title: {name} sent you a message
message.intro: Here's a preview of what {name} wrote:
message.note: To keep your inbox calm, we email you at most once every 30 minutes per conversation.

ticket.subject: We replied to your request: {subject}
ticket.preheader: There's a new reply from WagStays support.
ticket.title: We replied to your request
ticket.intro: Our support team replied to your request. Open it to read the reply and let us know if you need anything else.

owner.preheader: Your account is ready. Here's how to find the right sitter.
owner.intro: Your email is confirmed and your account is ready. Here's how to get started:
owner.stepPet: 1. Add your pet: tell sitters about their routine, quirks and favourite treats.
owner.stepSitter: 2. Find a sitter: browse trusted, background-checked sitters near you.
owner.stepMeet: 3. Book a free Meet & Greet: meet your sitter before the first booking, at no cost.
owner.pending: We're reviewing new accounts by hand right now. You can browse sitters in the meantime, and we'll email you as soon as you're approved to book.

sitter.preheader: One more step to start sitting with WagStays.
sitter.intro: Your email is confirmed. One more step to start sitting with WagStays: finish your sitter application.
sitter.next: Once it's in, you'll book a short video Meet & Greet with our team, and we'll review your documents.
sitter.inReview: Your application {code} is in review. You can check its status at any time.

received.subject: We received your application
received.title: We received your application
received.intro: Thanks for applying to sit with WagStays! Our team is now reviewing your application.
received.next: Next step: book your 15-minute video Meet & Greet with our team from your status page.
received.note: Keep your tracking code handy: you'll need it to check your status.

meetGreet.subject: Your Meet & Greet is booked for {when}
meetGreet.subjectChanged: Your Meet & Greet was moved to {when}
meetGreet.title: Your Meet & Greet is booked
meetGreet.titleChanged: Your Meet & Greet has a new time
meetGreet.intro: It's a 15-minute video call with our team to get to know you and answer your questions.
meetGreet.link: We'll email you the video call link before your appointment.
meetGreet.note: Need a different time? You can change it from your status page.

approved.subject: Welcome to the WagStays sitter team 🎉
approved.title: Welcome to the WagStays sitter team
approved.intro: Great news: your application is approved and your sitter profile is live!
approved.next: Head to your sitter dashboard to set your availability, review your services and add photos so pet parents can get to know you.
approved.newAccount: First time signing in? On the login page, choose “Forgot your password?” with this email address to set your password.

rejected.subject: An update on your WagStays application
rejected.preheader: Thank you for applying to sit with WagStays.
rejected.title: An update on your application
rejected.intro: Thank you for applying to sit with WagStays and for the time you put into your application.
rejected.body: After careful review, we're not able to move forward with it right now.
rejected.contact: Have a question? Write to us at {email}. We're happy to help.

approved.subject: You're all set to book 🐾
approved.title: You're all set to book
approved.intro: Good news: your WagStays account is approved. You can now book sitters.
approved.next: Haven't added your pet yet? Do it first so sitters know who they'll be caring for.

rejected.subject: An update on your WagStays account
rejected.title: An update on your account
rejected.intro: Thanks for joining WagStays. After reviewing your account, we're not able to approve it for booking right now. You can still browse sitters.
rejected.contact: Think this is a mistake, or have a question? Our support team is happy to help.
